You deserve to feel better. At Neuro Wellness Spa, our expertly trained psychiatrists and thoughtfully designed centers provide compassionate, personalized treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions, helping you achieve meaningful, lasting change.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
A pattern of using substances like drugs or alcohol often leads to harmful consequences to physical and mental health, work, or relationships.
ADHD is characterized by difficulty focusing, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with daily life.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
Between hormonal changes, the psychological adjustment to motherhood, and exhaustion, depression affects approximately 1 in 8 new mothers.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Sometimes stress can come on quickly and feel paralyzing. Panic attacks are sudden, intense, can happen unexpectedly, and affect daily functioning.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Difficulty falling or staying asleep leads not only to fatigue throughout the day, but often irritability and trouble focusing.
There are many causes for trouble with memory, thinking, or decision-making. For those with impairment, it interferes with everyday life or work.
For some, cognitive impairment is a progressive decline over time, and can affect independence and quality of life.
A condition marked by unstable moods, relationships, and self-image, often with intense emotional reactions.
A neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior patterns in varying degrees.
When pain lasts for months or longer, it takes a toll on a whole person, affecting not just physical functioning but mood as well.
Widespread pain, fatigue, and sleep issues aren’t always easy to explain. Those with fibromyalgia may also be unusually sensitive to touch and stress.
Everyone has bouts of exhaustion, but when it is not easily explained, doesn’t improve with rest, and limits your activities or mental clarity, it is considered chronic fatigue.
Although many people are concerned about health, weight, or appearance, those with eating disorders become fixated on weight loss, body shape, and controlling their food intake.

Our compassionate team at Neuro Wellness Spa works with you to determine the specialized mental health treatment that will work best for you. We are here with you every step of the way on your journey.

Our psychiatry services in Encino offer personalized mental health evaluations and treatment plans for anxiety, depression, trauma, and related conditions. We offer flexible scheduling, integrated therapy, and psychiatry, and a supportive, outcome-focused approach.

Our team provides psychiatric care designed to support teens facing challenges like anxiety, depression, ADHD, and mood disorders. We take a compassionate, family-informed approach and offer both in-person and virtual care options.

Therapy sessions are available for clients seeking support with anxiety, depression, trauma, and other emotional challenges. We offer personalized care, flexible scheduling, and a supportive, outcome-focused approach through talk therapy and evidence-based methods.

TMS is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive treatment for depression and other mental health conditions. Our Encino location offers TMS therapy, which is ideal for those who haven’t found relief through traditional treatments.

review.reviewBody: Thank you Neuro Wellness Spa! I highly recommend their treatment for anybody who is interested as this changed the trajectory of my mental health and recovery journey. Their equipment is state of the art and it has been my experience that it is highly effective for treating depression and anxiety. To have this alongside in my recovery has resulted in significant changes that has helped me take on life in a positive way. I no longer go through life weighed down by depression and anxiety thanks to Neuro Wellness's services.

I have been searching for something to help me work through my anxiety and depression for a very long time and I feel like I've finally found a treatment option that actually worked for me! Such a friendly group of staff and doctors who truly care for their patients, which is something quite hard to come by these days in the treatment field. 10/10 would recommend to any of my friends and family looking for an alternative to medication. Give them a try!

mainEntity.name: What services are available at Neuro Wellness Spa’s Encino location?

acceptedAnswer.text: At our Encino clinic, we provide a full spectrum of mental health services including in-person and virtual psychiatry, medication management, adolescent psychiatry, addiction psychiatry, psychotherapy (such as talk therapy, CBT, DBT, and addiction counseling), as well as advanced neuromodulation treatments like TMS therapy and MeRT.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer adult psychiatric care at your Encino clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Encino team delivers comprehensive adult psychiatric services through both in-person and online appointments, including medication management and specialized care options.

mainEntity.name: Is TMS therapy available onsite at the Encino location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely — TMS therapy is available at our Encino clinic, offering non-drug, FDA-cleared treatment for mood disorders. Additionally, we offer MeRT treatments.

mainEntity.name: Can I book an in-person therapy session in Encino?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can book in-person therapy at Encino. We offer various therapy modalities (including talk therapy, CBT, DBT, and addiction counseling) available both in-person and online.

mainEntity.name: Are virtual appointments available for Encino patients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Encino location offers virtual appointments across psychiatry, psychotherapy, and medication management, making care accessible from your home.

mainEntity.name: What insurance plans are accepted at the Encino location?

acceptedAnswer.text: We’re in-network with nearly all major insurance providers at Encino, including Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Blue Shield, Carelon (Beacon), Cigna, First Health, Health Net, Magellan, MHN, Optum, Tricare, UnitedHealthcare, UMR, and others.

mainEntity.name: What conditions do you treat at your Encino facility?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Encino, our team treats a wide range of mental health conditions such as depression, anxiety, stress, ADHD, bipolar disorder, OCD, PTSD, grief, and addiction — supporting patients with evidence-based psychiatric and therapeutic care.
